snippet.title: The Happy Pear
snippet.description:
Hey folks, thanks for stopping by!
We share one delicious, plant-based recipe video every week to help make healthy eating fun, vibrant, and downright irresistible.

We’re Dave & Steve, twin brothers who started The Happy Pear over 20 years ago with a humble fruit and veg shop. Since then, it’s grown into something pretty special,  we now have that same shop, a buzzing café and bakery, over 80 tasty plant-based food products, 15+ online courses (with over 100,000 people taking part!), a Recipe Club, 6 best-selling cookbooks, and a community of nearly 2 million across social media.

This channel is like a virtual cookbook, made to inspire anyone on their journey to health and happiness through a whole food, plant-based diet. Whether you're after a go-to weekday meal or something to wow your meat-loving mates, you'll find it here.

We’d love to connect with you, so feel free to jump into the Community section and say hello!

Dave & Steve 💚

snippet.title: なぜ日本だけ?
snippet.description:
「なぜ、日本はこれほどまでに美しいのか？」
日本の日常に眠る、目に見えない価値を「なぜ？」の視点で紐解きます。

snippet.title: The Provident Prepper
snippet.description:
Welcome to The Provident Prepper! We're Kylene and Jonathan Jones, and we believe preparedness is about empowerment, not fear. Our mission is to make emergency preparedness accessible and achievable for everyone through practical, common-sense solutions.
Find food storage tips, water solutions, emergency planning, self-reliance skills, and budget-friendly strategies. We're authors of "The Provident Prepper: A Common-Sense Guide to Preparing for Emergencies" and passionate about helping families build confidence and resilience. Join our positive community taking charge of their future, one practical step at a time. Together, we're building stronger families and communities through preparedness as a lifestyle of abundance.
Visit theprovidentprepper.org for more resources and tips! 🌱 Visit our sister channel @theprovidentgardener to learn about growing, producing, and cooking your own food!
#EmergencyPreparedness #SelfReliance #ProvidentLiving
